candidates.title: Use a received product image once

demandEvidence.chore: Pass an already received customer image and its message together to an AI agent so it can identify the product without asking for the image again.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want the AI agent to recognize that the image has already been received and use the available image to identify the product, rather than asking the customer to resend it

experimentPlan.output: A reviewable product description and a note saying whether the supplied message and image were both used.
experimentPlan.trigger: An operator submits one fictional message paired with one synthetic image.
steps: Pair the message with its existing image in one test record.
Send both inputs to a vision model in a sandbox.
Ask for a short product description and uncertainty note.
Compare the output with a hand-written expected category.
Record whether the test incorrectly asks for the image again.
experimentPlan.acceptanceCheck: For each of five fictional message-image pairs, compare the result with the expected category and flag any request to resend an image.
experimentPlan.humanBoundary: An operator supplies synthetic examples, checks image rights, reviews every output, and handles real customer conversations manually.
unverified: No supplied implementation reference documents image/message routing or Make execution.
Vision model access, image handling, accuracy and customer willingness to pay are unverified.

ease.reason: A small sandbox test can use paired examples, but no implementation reference is supplied.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: ecommerce support providers may pay to avoid repeated image requests; no buying intent is shown.

feasibility.reason: A synthetic paired-input test is bounded, though routing and image analysis support are undocumented here.

autonomy.reason: Pairing can be repeated in a prototype; a person must review uncertain identifications and manage real conversations.

evidence.reason: The retained span specifies the image-plus-message failure and desired behavior, but shows one workflow and no corroboration.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (4.8 mean): the post names a concrete image-context failure, but implementation support for image routing and analysis is absent from supplied references; proposed sandbox only.

candidates.title: Turn rough sketches into wireframe drafts

demandEvidence.chore: Translate a rough iPad sketch into a higher-fidelity wireframe or illustration quickly.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’ve been looking for a tool that can translate rough sketches on my iPad to higher fidelity wireframes or illustrations in near real time.

experimentPlan.output: A draft wireframe or illustration generated from a supplied rough sketch, with an editable review copy.
experimentPlan.trigger: A designer uploads one synthetic sketch and selects wireframe or illustration.
steps: Prepare five fictional rough sketches with expected key elements.
Submit each sketch and style instruction to a chosen image-generation tool.
Save the generated draft beside its input.
Compare whether key elements remain recognizable.
Have a designer mark corrections before reuse.
experimentPlan.acceptanceCheck: Check that each draft retains the expected screen regions and labels, then record whether a designer accepts it after edits.
experimentPlan.humanBoundary: A designer supplies sketches, checks rights and edits every draft; no generated artwork is delivered without review.
unverified: No supplied implementation reference establishes sketch-to-wireframe conversion.
Tool access, near-real-time speed, output editability and buyer willingness to pay are unverified.

ease.reason: A few manual image-generation trials are imaginable, but no relevant implementation reference is attached.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent interface designers may pay for faster sketch refinement; this request gives no payment evidence.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can compare generated drafts with synthetic sketches, but useful editable conversion is unverified.

autonomy.reason: Generating drafts may repeat, but a designer must direct style and correct each result.

evidence.reason: The fresh request states a desired sketch-to-wireframe/illustration task, with no detailed workflow or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (4.4 mean): the requested transformation is clear, but no supplied reference supports conversion quality, editability or speed.
